name: order_date
description: DATE(order_timestamp) in UTC. Partition column and the date used to attribute sales to a period.

name: order_status
description: Lifecycle status as of the data snapshot. Refund state is NOT stored here; see refunds.

name: sales_channel
description: Channel the order was placed through.

name: shipping_amount
description: Shipping charged to the customer (0.00 when merchandise net >= 75.00, else 6.99).

name: tax_amount
description: Sales tax = ROUND((items_subtotal - discount_amount) * regional rate, 2).

name: order_total
description: items_subtotal - discount_amount + shipping_amount + tax_amount. Amount the customer is asked to pay.

name: cancelled_timestamp
description: Set if and only if order_status = 'cancelled'.
